Principal Desk
For over six decades, D.K.D. College (Autonomous), Dergaon, has played a formative role in shaping the educational and intellectual landscape of the region. Established in 1962 with the vision of extending the reach of higher education to the people of the area, the College has evolved into an institution that combines a strong academic tradition with a deep sense of social commitment. Over the years, it has sought not merely to impart knowledge but to create an educational environment in which learning is accompanied by the development of character, competence, creativity, and civic responsibility.
The institutional journey of D.K.D. College (Autonomous) reflects a sustained pursuit of quality and continuous improvement. The college’s accreditation by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) with an A+ Grade and a CGPA of 3.37, together with the conferment of Autonomous Status, represents significant milestones in this journey. These recognitions affirm the College’s commitment to maintaining high standards across diverse dimensions of higher education, including teaching and learning, research, student development, institutional governance, infrastructure, extension activities, and community engagement. They also reflect the institution’s holistic approach to excellence, wherein academic achievement is viewed as one component of a much broader institutional vision.
Dr. Pranjol Protim Kakoty, M.A, Ph.D
Principal
D.K.D College Autonomous, Dergaon
